scientific_integrity: Universal claims proved symbolically; finite exact verifier is corroboration only. Existing fPO structural theorem is credited.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two agents, equally many chores of each of two types, reciprocal positive bivalued costs; fractional Pareto optimality rather than merely integral PO. Fixed positive cost contrast for entropy law; no independent publication-priority certification.
title: A binomial staircase and a singular counting transition for fair-efficient bivalued chores
